inputContext.request: Create a small, playable Sky Steps checkpoint parkour game for one player on desktop and touch. Build one coherent short course with three ordered checkpoints, a moving-platform crossing, a clearly marked fall hazard, and a finish. Players must physically traverse it; touching a later checkpoint early must not skip progress. Reaching a checkpoint shows visible activation animation and synchronized confirmation sound. Falling returns the player to the last valid checkpoint without losing progress. Show the current checkpoint and elapsed run time, then a completion result and deliberate replay control. Search Marketplace first for reusable checkpoint, moving-platform and course components, preserving useful existing behavior, visuals, motion and media. Inspect what is included and integrate missing rules rather than replacing working components wholesale. Use Marketplace audio and verify it actually plays. If a suitable component cannot be imported faithfully, record that capability gap. Use compact readable geometry and comfortable jumps; choose reasonable style and layout yourself. No multiplayer, saving, purchases or sprawling map. Success needs native traversal, ordered progression, moving-platform behavior, fall recovery, finish/replay and legible desktop/touch UI. A decorative obstacle scene or a timer alone is insufficient.

The fall hazard below is marked by a deep purple/crimson warning mist and safety hazard striping. Checkpoints visibly transition from a dim inactive amber state to a bright pulsing cyan aura upon activation. Clean modern UI with rounded corners, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, high-contrast typography, and dedicated touch-friendly buttons.

requirements.description: Construct a coherent aerial parkour course featuring a starting staging area, stepping stone jumps, 3 ordered checkpoint platforms, a gap requiring a moving-platform crossing, and an elevated finish platform.
requirements.sourceQuote: Create a small, playable Sky Steps checkpoint parkour game for one player on desktop and touch. Build one coherent short course with three ordered checkpoints, a moving-platform crossing, a clearly marked fall hazard, and a finish. Players must physically traverse it; touching a later checkpoint early must not skip progress. Reaching a checkpoint shows visible activation animation and synchronized confirmation sound. Falling returns the player to the last valid checkpoint without losing progress. Show the current checkpoint and elapsed run time, then a completion result and deliberate replay control. Search Marketplace first for reusable checkpoint, moving-platform and course components, preserving useful existing behavior, visuals, motion and media. Inspect what is included and integrate missing rules rather than replacing working components wholesale. Use Marketplace audio and verify it actually plays. If a suitable component cannot be imported faithfully, record that capability gap. Use compact readable geometry and comfortable jumps; choose reasonable style and layout yourself. No multiplayer, saving, purchases or sprawling map. Success needs native traversal, ordered progression, moving-platform behavior, fall recovery, finish/replay and legible desktop/touch UI. A decorative obstacle scene or a timer alone is insufficient.
requirements.acceptance: Course geometry exists in the workspace namespace with reachable jump distances (under 16 studs per jump) leading from Start -> CP1 -> CP2 -> Moving Platform -> CP3 -> Finish.

playerExperience.title: Sky Steps - Checkpoint Parkour
playerExperience.summary: Sky Steps is an aerial parkour obstacle course designed for a single player on desktop and touch devices. The player begins at a start platform floating in the sky overlooking a sequence of elevated stepping stones, 3 sequential checkpoints, an oscillating moving platform crossing, and a finish portal. Stepping onto checkpoint 1 activates its glow and plays a confirmation chime. Checkpoints must be reached strictly in order (1 -> 2 -> 3); skipping ahead is ignored by server validation. Falling below the course into the clearly marked hazard plane smoothly teleports the player back to their last activated checkpoint without losing run progress. An on-screen HUD displays the active checkpoint ratio (e.g. 1/3) and elapsed timer. Reaching the finish displays a victory summary screen with final time and a dedicated 'Play Again' replay button that resets the course and timer.

playerExperience.title: Sky Steps - Checkpoint Parkour
playerExperience.summary: Sky Steps is an aerial parkour obstacle course designed for a single player on desktop and touch devices. The player begins at a start platform floating in the sky overlooking a sequence of elevated stepping stones, 3 sequential checkpoints, an oscillating moving platform crossing, and a finish portal. Stepping onto checkpoint 1 activates its glow and plays a confirmation chime. Checkpoints must be reached strictly in order (1 -> 2 -> 3); skipping ahead is ignored by server validation. Falling below the course into the clearly marked hazard plane smoothly teleports the player back to their last activated checkpoint without losing run progress. An on-screen HUD displays the active checkpoint ratio (e.g. 1/3) and elapsed timer. Reaching the finish displays a victory summary screen with final time and a dedicated 'Play Again' replay button that resets the course and timer.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Stylized vibrant sky aesthetic featuring floating islands, sleek neon-edged stepping platforms, and glowing cyan/amber checkpoint beacons. The skybox features soft gradients and fluffy clouds. Safe platforms use crisp stone and metallic borders with high-contrast surfaces. The fall hazard below is marked by a deep purple/crimson warning mist and safety hazard striping. Checkpoints visibly transition from a dim inactive amber state to a bright pulsing cyan aura upon activation. Clean modern UI with rounded corners, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, high-contrast typography, and dedicated touch-friendly buttons.

inputContext.request: Create a small, playable Sky Steps checkpoint parkour game for one player on desktop and touch. Build one coherent short course with three ordered checkpoints, a moving-platform crossing, a clearly marked fall hazard, and a finish. Players must physically traverse it; touching a later checkpoint early must not skip progress. Reaching a checkpoint shows visible activation animation and synchronized confirmation sound. Falling returns the player to the last valid checkpoint without losing progress. Show the current checkpoint and elapsed run time, then a completion result and deliberate replay control. Search Marketplace first for reusable checkpoint, moving-platform and course components, preserving useful existing behavior, visuals, motion and media. Inspect what is included and integrate missing rules rather than replacing working components wholesale. Use Marketplace audio and verify it actually plays. If a suitable component cannot be imported faithfully, record that capability gap. Use compact readable geometry and comfortable jumps; choose reasonable style and layout yourself. No multiplayer, saving, purchases or sprawling map. Success needs native traversal, ordered progression, moving-platform behavior, fall recovery, finish/replay and legible desktop/touch UI. A decorative obstacle scene or a timer alone is insufficient.

playerExperience.title: Sky Steps - Checkpoint Parkour
playerExperience.summary: Sky Steps is an aerial parkour obstacle course designed for a single player on desktop and touch devices. The player begins at a start platform floating in the sky overlooking a sequence of elevated stepping stones, 3 sequential checkpoints, an oscillating moving platform crossing, and a finish portal. Stepping onto checkpoint 1 activates its glow and plays a confirmation chime. Checkpoints must be reached strictly in order (1 -> 2 -> 3); skipping ahead is ignored by server validation. Falling below the course into the clearly marked hazard plane smoothly teleports the player back to their last activated checkpoint without losing run progress. An on-screen HUD displays the active checkpoint ratio (e.g. 1/3) and elapsed timer. Reaching the finish displays a victory summary screen with final time and a dedicated 'Play Again' replay button that resets the course and timer.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Stylized vibrant sky aesthetic featuring floating islands, sleek neon-edged stepping platforms, and glowing cyan/amber checkpoint beacons. The skybox features soft gradients and fluffy clouds. Safe platforms use crisp stone and metallic borders with high-contrast surfaces. The fall hazard below is marked by a deep purple/crimson warning mist and safety hazard striping. Checkpoints visibly transition from a dim inactive amber state to a bright pulsing cyan aura upon activation. Clean modern UI with rounded corners, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, high-contrast typography, and dedicated touch-friendly buttons.

playerExperience.title: Sky Steps - Checkpoint Parkour
playerExperience.summary: Sky Steps is an aerial parkour obstacle course designed for a single player on desktop and touch devices. The player begins at a start platform floating in the sky overlooking a sequence of elevated stepping stones, 3 sequential checkpoints, an oscillating moving platform crossing, and a finish portal. Stepping onto checkpoint 1 activates its glow and plays a confirmation chime. Checkpoints must be reached strictly in order (1 -> 2 -> 3); skipping ahead is ignored by server validation. Falling below the course into the clearly marked hazard plane smoothly teleports the player back to their last activated checkpoint without losing run progress. An on-screen HUD displays the active checkpoint ratio (e.g. 1/3) and elapsed timer. Reaching the finish displays a victory summary screen with final time and a dedicated 'Play Again' replay button that resets the course and timer.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Stylized vibrant sky aesthetic featuring floating islands, sleek neon-edged stepping platforms, and glowing cyan/amber checkpoint beacons. The skybox features soft gradients and fluffy clouds. Safe platforms use crisp stone and metallic borders with high-contrast surfaces. The fall hazard below is marked by a deep purple/crimson warning mist and safety hazard striping. Checkpoints visibly transition from a dim inactive amber state to a bright pulsing cyan aura upon activation. Clean modern UI with rounded corners, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, high-contrast typography, and dedicated touch-friendly buttons.

playerExperience.title: Sky Steps - Checkpoint Parkour
playerExperience.summary: Sky Steps is an aerial parkour obstacle course designed for a single player on desktop and touch devices. The player begins at a start platform floating in the sky overlooking a sequence of elevated stepping stones, 3 sequential checkpoints, an oscillating moving platform crossing, and a finish portal. Stepping onto checkpoint 1 activates its glow and plays a confirmation chime. Checkpoints must be reached strictly in order (1 -> 2 -> 3); skipping ahead is ignored by server validation. Falling below the course into the clearly marked hazard plane smoothly teleports the player back to their last activated checkpoint without losing run progress. An on-screen HUD displays the active checkpoint ratio (e.g. 1/3) and elapsed timer. Reaching the finish displays a victory summary screen with final time and a dedicated 'Play Again' replay button that resets the course and timer.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Stylized vibrant sky aesthetic featuring floating islands, sleek neon-edged stepping platforms, and glowing cyan/amber checkpoint beacons. The skybox features soft gradients and fluffy clouds. Safe platforms use crisp stone and metallic borders with high-contrast surfaces. The fall hazard below is marked by a deep purple/crimson warning mist and safety hazard striping. Checkpoints visibly transition from a dim inactive amber state to a bright pulsing cyan aura upon activation. Clean modern UI with rounded corners, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, high-contrast typography, and dedicated touch-friendly buttons.

playerExperience.summary: Sky Steps is an aerial parkour obstacle course designed for a single player on desktop and touch devices. The player begins at a start platform floating in the sky overlooking a sequence of elevated stepping stones, 3 sequential checkpoints, an oscillating moving platform crossing, and a finish portal. Stepping onto checkpoint 1 activates its glow and plays a confirmation chime. Checkpoints must be reached strictly in order (1 -> 2 -> 3); skipping ahead is ignored by server validation. Falling below the course into the clearly marked hazard plane smoothly teleports the player back to their last activated checkpoint without losing run progress. An on-screen HUD displays the active checkpoint ratio (e.g. 1/3) and elapsed timer. Reaching the finish displays a victory summary screen with final time and a dedicated 'Play Again' replay button that resets the course and timer.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Stylized vibrant sky aesthetic featuring floating islands, sleek neon-edged stepping platforms, and glowing cyan/amber checkpoint beacons. The skybox features soft gradients and fluffy clouds. Safe platforms use crisp stone and metallic borders with high-contrast surfaces. The fall hazard below is marked by a deep purple/crimson warning mist and safety hazard striping. Checkpoints visibly transition from a dim inactive amber state to a bright pulsing cyan aura upon activation. Clean modern UI with rounded corners, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, high-contrast typography, and dedicated touch-friendly buttons.

requirements.description: Construct a coherent aerial parkour course featuring a starting staging area, stepping stone jumps, 3 ordered checkpoint platforms, a gap requiring a moving-platform crossing, and an elevated finish platform.

Build one coherent short course with three ordered checkpoints, a moving-platform crossing, a clearly marked fall hazard, and a finish. Falling returns the player to the last valid checkpoint without losing progress. Show the current checkpoint and elapsed run time, then a completion result and deliberate replay control. local spawn = script.Parent
spawn.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit and hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local checkpointData = game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("CheckpointData")
		if not checkpointData then
			checkpointData = Instance.new("Model", game.ServerStorage)
			checkpointData.Name = "CheckpointData"
		end
		
		local checkpoint = checkpointData:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.userId))
		if not checkpoint then
			checkpoint = Instance.new("ObjectValue", checkpointData)
			checkpoint.Name = tostring(player.userId)
			
			player.CharacterAdded:connect(function(character)
				wait()
				character:WaitForChild("Torso").CFrame = game.ServerStorage.CheckpointData[tostring(player.userId)].Value.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
			end)
		end
		
		checkpoint.Value = spawn
	end
end)

playerExperience.title: Sky Steps - Checkpoint Parkour
playerExperience.summary: Sky Steps is an aerial parkour obstacle course designed for a single player on desktop and touch devices. The player begins at a start platform floating in the sky overlooking a sequence of elevated stepping stones, 3 sequential checkpoints, an oscillating moving platform crossing, and a finish portal. Stepping onto checkpoint 1 activates its glow and plays a confirmation chime. Checkpoints must be reached strictly in order (1 -> 2 -> 3); skipping ahead is ignored by server validation. Falling below the course into the clearly marked hazard plane smoothly teleports the player back to their last activated checkpoint without losing run progress. An on-screen HUD displays the active checkpoint ratio (e.g. 1/3) and elapsed timer. Reaching the finish displays a victory summary screen with final time and a dedicated 'Play Again' replay button that resets the course and timer.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Stylized vibrant sky aesthetic featuring floating islands, sleek neon-edged stepping platforms, and glowing cyan/amber checkpoint beacons. The skybox features soft gradients and fluffy clouds. Safe platforms use crisp stone and metallic borders with high-contrast surfaces. The fall hazard below is marked by a deep purple/crimson warning mist and safety hazard striping. Checkpoints visibly transition from a dim inactive amber state to a bright pulsing cyan aura upon activation. Clean modern UI with rounded corners, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, high-contrast typography, and dedicated touch-friendly buttons.

local spawn = script.Parent
spawn.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit and hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local checkpointData = game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("CheckpointData")
		if not checkpointData then
			checkpointData = Instance.new("Model", game.ServerStorage)
			checkpointData.Name = "CheckpointData"
		end
		
		local checkpoint = checkpointData:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.userId))
		if not checkpoint then
			checkpoint = Instance.new("ObjectValue", checkpointData)
			checkpoint.Name = tostring(player.userId)
			
			player.CharacterAdded:connect(function(character)
				wait()
				character:WaitForChild("Torso").CFrame = game.ServerStorage.CheckpointData[tostring(player.userId)].Value.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
			end)
		end
		
		checkpoint.Value = spawn
	end
end)

playerExperience.title: Sky Steps - Checkpoint Parkour
playerExperience.summary: Sky Steps is an aerial parkour obstacle course designed for a single player on desktop and touch devices. The player begins at a start platform floating in the sky overlooking a sequence of elevated stepping stones, 3 sequential checkpoints, an oscillating moving platform crossing, and a finish portal. Stepping onto checkpoint 1 activates its glow and plays a confirmation chime. Checkpoints must be reached strictly in order (1 -> 2 -> 3); skipping ahead is ignored by server validation. Falling below the course into the clearly marked hazard plane smoothly teleports the player back to their last activated checkpoint without losing run progress. An on-screen HUD displays the active checkpoint ratio (e.g. 1/3) and elapsed timer. Reaching the finish displays a victory summary screen with final time and a dedicated 'Play Again' replay button that resets the course and timer.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Stylized vibrant sky aesthetic featuring floating islands, sleek neon-edged stepping platforms, and glowing cyan/amber checkpoint beacons. The skybox features soft gradients and fluffy clouds. Safe platforms use crisp stone and metallic borders with high-contrast surfaces. The fall hazard below is marked by a deep purple/crimson warning mist and safety hazard striping. Checkpoints visibly transition from a dim inactive amber state to a bright pulsing cyan aura upon activation. Clean modern UI with rounded corners, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, high-contrast typography, and dedicated touch-friendly buttons.

local spawn = script.Parent
spawn.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit and hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local checkpointData = game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("CheckpointData")
		if not checkpointData then
			checkpointData = Instance.new("Model", game.ServerStorage)
			checkpointData.Name = "CheckpointData"
		end
		
		local checkpoint = checkpointData:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.userId))
		if not checkpoint then
			checkpoint = Instance.new("ObjectValue", checkpointData)
			checkpoint.Name = tostring(player.userId)
			
			player.CharacterAdded:connect(function(character)
				wait()
				character:WaitForChild("Torso").CFrame = game.ServerStorage.CheckpointData[tostring(player.userId)].Value.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
			end)
		end
		
		checkpoint.Value = spawn
	end
end)

playerExperience.title: Sky Steps - Checkpoint Parkour
playerExperience.summary: Sky Steps is an aerial parkour obstacle course designed for a single player on desktop and touch devices. The player begins at a start platform floating in the sky overlooking a sequence of elevated stepping stones, 3 sequential checkpoints, an oscillating moving platform crossing, and a finish portal. Stepping onto checkpoint 1 activates its glow and plays a confirmation chime. Checkpoints must be reached strictly in order (1 -> 2 -> 3); skipping ahead is ignored by server validation. Falling below the course into the clearly marked hazard plane smoothly teleports the player back to their last activated checkpoint without losing run progress. An on-screen HUD displays the active checkpoint ratio (e.g. 1/3) and elapsed timer. Reaching the finish displays a victory summary screen with final time and a dedicated 'Play Again' replay button that resets the course and timer.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Stylized vibrant sky aesthetic featuring floating islands, sleek neon-edged stepping platforms, and glowing cyan/amber checkpoint beacons. The skybox features soft gradients and fluffy clouds. Safe platforms use crisp stone and metallic borders with high-contrast surfaces. The fall hazard below is marked by a deep purple/crimson warning mist and safety hazard striping. Checkpoints visibly transition from a dim inactive amber state to a bright pulsing cyan aura upon activation. Clean modern UI with rounded corners, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, high-contrast typography, and dedicated touch-friendly buttons.

local spawn = script.Parent
spawn.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit and hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local checkpointData = game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("CheckpointData")
		if not checkpointData then
			checkpointData = Instance.new("Model", game.ServerStorage)
			checkpointData.Name = "CheckpointData"
		end
		
		local checkpoint = checkpointData:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.userId))
		if not checkpoint then
			checkpoint = Instance.new("ObjectValue", checkpointData)
			checkpoint.Name = tostring(player.userId)
			
			player.CharacterAdded:connect(function(character)
				wait()
				character:WaitForChild("Torso").CFrame = game.ServerStorage.CheckpointData[tostring(player.userId)].Value.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
			end)
		end
		
		checkpoint.Value = spawn
	end
end)

Falling returns the player to the last valid checkpoint without losing progress. Show the current checkpoint and elapsed run time, then a completion result and deliberate replay control. A decorative obstacle scene or a timer alone is insufficient.

playerExperience.title: Sky Steps - Checkpoint Parkour
playerExperience.summary: Sky Steps is an aerial parkour obstacle course designed for a single player on desktop and touch devices. The player begins at a start platform floating in the sky overlooking a sequence of elevated stepping stones, 3 sequential checkpoints, an oscillating moving platform crossing, and a finish portal. Stepping onto checkpoint 1 activates its glow and plays a confirmation chime. Checkpoints must be reached strictly in order (1 -> 2 -> 3); skipping ahead is ignored by server validation. Falling below the course into the clearly marked hazard plane smoothly teleports the player back to their last activated checkpoint without losing run progress. An on-screen HUD displays the active checkpoint ratio (e.g. 1/3) and elapsed timer. Reaching the finish displays a victory summary screen with final time and a dedicated 'Play Again' replay button that resets the course and timer.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Stylized vibrant sky aesthetic featuring floating islands, sleek neon-edged stepping platforms, and glowing cyan/amber checkpoint beacons. The skybox features soft gradients and fluffy clouds. Safe platforms use crisp stone and metallic borders with high-contrast surfaces. The fall hazard below is marked by a deep purple/crimson warning mist and safety hazard striping. Checkpoints visibly transition from a dim inactive amber state to a bright pulsing cyan aura upon activation. Clean modern UI with rounded corners, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, high-contrast typography, and dedicated touch-friendly buttons.

local spawn = script.Parent
spawn.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit and hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local checkpointData = game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("CheckpointData")
		if not checkpointData then
			checkpointData = Instance.new("Model", game.ServerStorage)
			checkpointData.Name = "CheckpointData"
		end
		
		local checkpoint = checkpointData:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.userId))
		if not checkpoint then
			checkpoint = Instance.new("ObjectValue", checkpointData)
			checkpoint.Name = tostring(player.userId)
			
			player.CharacterAdded:connect(function(character)
				wait()
				character:WaitForChild("Torso").CFrame = game.ServerStorage.CheckpointData[tostring(player.userId)].Value.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
			end)
		end
		
		checkpoint.Value = spawn
	end
end)

playerExperience.title: Sky Steps - Checkpoint Parkour
playerExperience.summary: Sky Steps is an aerial parkour obstacle course designed for a single player on desktop and touch devices. The player begins at a start platform floating in the sky overlooking a sequence of elevated stepping stones, 3 sequential checkpoints, an oscillating moving platform crossing, and a finish portal. Stepping onto checkpoint 1 activates its glow and plays a confirmation chime. Checkpoints must be reached strictly in order (1 -> 2 -> 3); skipping ahead is ignored by server validation. Falling below the course into the clearly marked hazard plane smoothly teleports the player back to their last activated checkpoint without losing run progress. An on-screen HUD displays the active checkpoint ratio (e.g. 1/3) and elapsed timer. Reaching the finish displays a victory summary screen with final time and a dedicated 'Play Again' replay button that resets the course and timer.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Stylized vibrant sky aesthetic featuring floating islands, sleek neon-edged stepping platforms, and glowing cyan/amber checkpoint beacons. The skybox features soft gradients and fluffy clouds. Safe platforms use crisp stone and metallic borders with high-contrast surfaces. The fall hazard below is marked by a deep purple/crimson warning mist and safety hazard striping. Checkpoints visibly transition from a dim inactive amber state to a bright pulsing cyan aura upon activation. Clean modern UI with rounded corners, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, high-contrast typography, and dedicated touch-friendly buttons.

local spawn = script.Parent
spawn.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit and hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local checkpointData = game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("CheckpointData")
		if not checkpointData then
			checkpointData = Instance.new("Model", game.ServerStorage)
			checkpointData.Name = "CheckpointData"
		end
		
		local checkpoint = checkpointData:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.userId))
		if not checkpoint then
			checkpoint = Instance.new("ObjectValue", checkpointData)
			checkpoint.Name = tostring(player.userId)
			
			player.CharacterAdded:connect(function(character)
				wait()
				character:WaitForChild("Torso").CFrame = game.ServerStorage.CheckpointData[tostring(player.userId)].Value.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
			end)
		end
		
		checkpoint.Value = spawn
	end
end)
